title: Charm Unlock
tagline: Twist the rings, set the charms free.
trayFullText: Try releasing the same colors one after another.
devNote: Development build. Tap the board once to enable sound.
hint.Öğretici: Drag a ring to turn it. Bring its gap to where it crosses a neighbour. A glowing ring is free: tap it.
hint.Öğretici: tepsi: 3 charms of the same color merge in the tray. If all 5 slots fill up, you lose. Each turn costs 1 move; tapping is free.
hint.Yeni: pim: New: golden pin! A pinned ring only comes off when its gap sits on the pin.
hint.Normal: Count your moves: which ring opens the way for the others?
hint.Zor: Hard level! Three colors: don't release them in an order that fills the tray.
hint.Dinlenme: Take a breath: an easy bracelet.
hint.Normal+: Ring necklace: the middle ring is linked to everyone.
hint.Süper zor: Super hard! No spare moves: every turn must count.
